items.title: Delhi HC asks Centre, CBFC, film producers to decide on adding accessibility features in cinema, OTT for disabled
items.summary: The Delhi High Court has directed the Union Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB), Central Board Of Film Certification (CBFC), Mythri Movie Makers and other relevant stakeholders to deliberate upon adding accessibility features in films released in cinema and over-the-top (OTT) platforms for disabled audience [ Rahul Bajaj vs. Mythri Movie Makers And Ors ]. Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma passed the directions on August 10 while hearing a petition filed by disability rights activist and lawyer Rahul Bajaj. "This Court considers it appropriate to afford an opportunity to all concerned stakeholders to deliberate upon the issue and explore a mutually acceptable resolution. Accordingly, a joint meeting of all stakeholders, including the petitioner and the respondents, shall be convened within a period of one week from today to consider the broader concerns regarding accessibility of films raised by the petitioner," the order said. The Court directed the stakeholders to reach a workable resolution in this regard within two weeks.
